description: How much epoxy floor coating to buy: coverage per gallon at your dry film thickness and volume solids, gallons per coat, total with losses, and kits. Formula: Coverage (sq ft/gal) = 1,604 × solids by volume ÷ dry mils. Gallons per coat = area ÷ coverage. Total = gallons per coat × coats × (1 + loss). Wet mils = dry mils ÷ solids.

dry_mils_per_coat.description: Dry film thickness per coat (from the data sheet) (mils); default 8

solids_pct.description: Solids by volume (from the data sheet) (%); default 100

name: calc_epoxy_floor
title: Epoxy Floor Calculator (Gallons and Kits by Mils and Solids)
